cards.front: Short hand on a clock
cards.back: The short hand is the hour hand. It tells you the hour.
cards.say: The short hand on a clock is the hour hand. It tells you the hour.

cards.front: Long hand on a clock
cards.back: The long hand is the minute hand. It tells you the minutes.
cards.say: The long hand on a clock is the minute hand. It tells you the minutes.

cards.front: o'clock
cards.back: The long hand points to 12. At 4 o'clock the short hand points to 4.
cards.say: O'clock. The long hand points to twelve. At four o'clock the short hand points to four.

cards.front: Half past
cards.back: The long hand points to 6. Half past 4 is 30 minutes after 4 o'clock.
cards.say: Half past. The long hand points to six. Half past four is thirty minutes after four o'clock.

cards.front: Long hand on 12, short hand on 3. What time?
cards.say: Long hand on twelve, short hand on three. What time? Three o'clock.

cards.front: Long hand on 6, short hand between 7 and 8. What time?
cards.say: Long hand on six, short hand between seven and eight. What time? Half past seven.

cards.front: Read the clock.
cards.say: Read the clock. Seven o'clock.

cards.front: What time is shown?
cards.say: What time is shown? Two o'clock.

cards.front: Tell the time on this clock.
cards.back: Half past 5. The long hand is on 6.
cards.say: Tell the time on this clock. Half past five. The long hand is on six.

figure.alt: A clock showing half past five.

cards.front: What time does the clock show?
cards.say: What time does the clock show? Eleven o'clock.

cards.front: Which time is on the clock?
cards.say: Which time is on the clock? Half past nine.

figure.alt: A clock showing half past nine.

cards.front: Where is the long hand at 8 o'clock?
cards.say: Where is the long hand at eight o'clock? On the twelve.

cards.front: Where is the long hand at half past 8?
cards.say: Where is the long hand at half past eight? On the six.

cards.front: Where is the short hand at 10 o'clock?
cards.say: Where is the short hand at ten o'clock? Pointing to the ten.

cards.front: How many hours are in one day?
cards.say: How many hours are in one day? Twenty-four hours.

cards.front: How many minutes are in one hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in one hour? Sixty minutes.

cards.front: How many minutes are in half an hour?
cards.say: How many minutes are in half an hour? Thirty minutes.

cards.front: What time is it one hour after 3 o'clock?
cards.say: What time is it one hour after three o'clock? Four o'clock.

cards.front: What time is it one hour after 11 o'clock?
cards.say: What time is it one hour after eleven o'clock? Twelve o'clock.

cards.front: What time is it one hour before 6 o'clock?
cards.say: What time is it one hour before six o'clock? Five o'clock.

cards.front: What do we call 12 o'clock in the middle of the day?
cards.back: Noon (midday). The morning is before it and the afternoon is after it.
cards.say: What do we call twelve o'clock in the middle of the day? Noon, or midday. The morning is before it and the afternoon is after it.

cards.front: In which part of the day do you eat breakfast?
cards.say: In which part of the day do you eat breakfast? Morning.

cards.front: When do you usually sleep in bed?
cards.say: When do you usually sleep in bed? At night.

cards.front: Which is longer: one hour or half an hour?
cards.back: One hour. It is 60 minutes, and half an hour is 30 minutes.
cards.say: Which is longer: one hour or half an hour? One hour. It is sixty minutes, and half an hour is thirty minutes.
